question: Should the already-bundled SenseAudio plugin gain a bundled web-search provider, and if so may an existing transcription-only `SENSEAUDIO_API_KEY` automatically change unpinned web-search selection?
rationale: This is a new optional provider and changes provider-routing behavior for existing credentials; source inspection can identify the compatibility effect but cannot choose the permanent product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Sponsor bundled provider with opt-in selection
options.body: Keep the provider in the bundled SenseAudio plugin but prevent a transcription-only environment key from changing web-search routing until the operator explicitly selects or configures SenseAudio search.

options.title: Accept automatic selection
options.body: Keep order-45 auto-detection and document that existing unpinned web-search setups with `SENSEAUDIO_API_KEY` intentionally change provider on upgrade.

options.title: Route as an external plugin
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin focused on media understanding and publish SenseAudio web search through the existing external plugin surface instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled provider with opt-in selection
recommendation.body: Keep the provider in the bundled SenseAudio plugin but prevent a transcription-only environment key from changing web-search routing until the operator explicitly selects or configures SenseAudio search.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor explicitly requested their product review based on prior routing for the bundled SenseAudio and web-search surfaces.
